blurb: Battlefield Vegas is an exciting shooting range located just off the Las Vegas Strip. It offers both indoor and outdoor ranges, where visitors can experience shooting a wide variety of firearms, from handguns and pistols to fully automatic rifles and .50 caliber machine guns. The facility also features a realistic military setting with over 1,000 different weapons systems, military vehicles, and even a tank crushing experience. It's a thrilling destination for anyone looking to enjoy some high adrenaline fun!
